scope.resident_persisted_cached_view: Fresh TCP connection, authentication, selected DAG and marker checks, authoritative core provisioning, state mkdir, file fsync, rename and response. No acquisition or child launch.
scope.resident_durable_submit: Fresh TCP connection, spec resolution, private durable submission, detached worker spawn acknowledgement, response. Excludes worker initialization and tenant execution.
scope.accepted_to_worker_control_ready: Observed from submit response to private worker endpoint record. Includes worker process startup; 1 ms file polling adds measurement overhead. It is not raw child startup.
scope.complete_submit_through_verified_child_e: Submission through worker terminal metadata and captured child exit, including real Node dataset computation and output/state writes. 1 ms polling overhead included; output correctness checked after timing.
scope.raw_node_child_startup: spawn through exit/stdout drain for an independent Node child; no view or resident worker.
scope.resident_ping: Fresh TCP connection through authentication and response; no job or view operation.

limits: Host-specific warm filesystem measurements, not hardware-independent guarantees.
Cold acquisitions are single offline observations, without network/resolver latency.
No full-system reboot/power-loss durability test. Core fsyncs files, not parent directories.
Worker pool reuse is not implemented: each job starts an independent Node worker and tenant process.
Benchmarks run sequentially after integration; percentiles retain outliers without trimming.
